# Lower unary consumer with a type token

One complete lower unary consumer and an invariant token bind the same
Object-bounded formal in a void call beside fixed nominal context. Public,
package nested and virtual entries retain actual calls and destination identity.

Frozen source, package-source and SDK observers check live mutations, field
snapshots, late element casts, ignored calls, null order and checked/Error
identity before and after an applied write. Wrong programs must fail the oracle
and original signatures, flags, class/method identities and Exceptions remain.
